title: Benign MCP manifest must NOT fire A5 YARA rules
description: False-positive guard for A5. A normal MCP manifest with benign tool descriptions (weather, calendar, file-listing) should produce zero A5 findings. If this case starts firing A5, Cisco's YARA rules have over-generalized or our integration is misclassifying.
source_notes: Locks the FP-guard for A5. Updates to vendored Cisco rules should not start firing on innocent text.
